# Hartwell Labs

> Independent engineering company from Szczecin, Poland, building security infrastructure and developer tools. Open source, MIT licensed, CI on everything.

Core facts:

- Flagship product: **talus-process-monitor** — behavioral ransomware detection and response for Linux. eBPF-based, ~280k events per second, seccomp and Landlock self-sandboxing, one static binary, no kernel modules.
- Ships with: SBOM (SPDX), build provenance, Sigstore-style attestation, continuous fuzzing on the eBPF pipeline.
- Security: coordinated vulnerability disclosure, 48-hour acknowledgment SLA, security contact in /.well-known/security.txt.
- Services: manual penetration testing (OWASP WSTG, PTES), Amazon SP-API audit-ready assessments, Linux hardening, eBPF detection deployments.
- Team: Bartosz Osiej (Founder & CEO, systems engineering), duds08422-max (Ruby engineering, bridges & registry).
